dialogues.jp:
何故か知らないが、足が学園へと向かってしま
う。今日は日曜だってのに……。
dialogues.en: My body was drawn towards the school. It's Sunday......
dialogues.text: My body was drawn towards the school. It's Sunday......

dialogues.jp:
「……もしや、運命の出会いでもあるのか？　
　美少女転校生とぶつかるとか？」
dialogues.en:
"......Is there someone special waiting for me? Am I going
to run into a beautiful new female student?"
dialogues.text:
"......Is there someone special waiting for me? Am I going
to run into a beautiful new female student?"

dialogues.en: "That's not possible. I refuse to believe it."
dialogues.text: "That's not possible. I refuse to believe it."

dialogues.jp:
振り返った杉並から逃れるべく、桜の影に隠れ
る。
dialogues.en:
I hid behind the cherry blossom tree when Suginami turned
around.
dialogues.text:
I hid behind the cherry blossom tree when Suginami turned
around.

dialogues.jp: 幹から覗き見ると、奴の姿は消えていた。
dialogues.en: He was already gone when I peeked from behind the tree.
dialogues.text: He was already gone when I peeked from behind the tree.

dialogues.jp:
「しかし、あいつ、学園に何の用だ？　日曜だっ
　てのに……」

「まさか、本当に運命？　杉並エンド？
　……あわっ！　真冬のような寒気が！」
dialogues.en:
"No, it can't be. It was Suginami I'm supposed to find?
......Arrgg! I felt a shiver run up my spine!"
dialogues.text:
"No, it can't be. It was Suginami I'm supposed to find?
......Arrgg! I felt a shiver run up my spine!"

dialogues.jp: ぶるぶると震えながら、家へと急ぐ俺であった。
dialogues.en: I headed back home still feeling the shiver.
dialogues.text: I headed back home still feeling the shiver.

dialogues.jp:
何故だか知らないが、日曜だというのに、学園
へと向かう俺の足。もしや、運命の出会い……。
dialogues.en:
My body was pulled towards the school on Sunday for some
reason. Does this mean someone special's waiting for me
there......?
dialogues.text:
My body was pulled towards the school on Sunday for some
reason. Does this mean someone special's waiting for me
there......?

dialogues.en: I won't accept that it was Suginami.
dialogues.text: I won't accept that it was Suginami.
